ValidationRule.description: 90 day limit to New Date. When User requests an extension to Training End Date by manually filling out New Training End Date, it cannot be more than 90 Days extension --- Jira Ticket SS-1049 - Deactivate VR
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND ( $Profile.Name <>'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <>'Tanium System Administrator', $User.Id <> "0050e000006z7Ef", New_Training_End_Date__c - Training_End_Date__c > 90 ) /* AND (
$Profile.Name <>'Tanium System Administrator', $User.Id <> "0050e000006z7Ef", New_Training_End_Date__c - Training_End_Date__c > 90 )*/
ValidationRule.errorMessage: New Training End Date cannot be beyond 90 days from Current Training End Date
